You’re greeted by the familiar smell of pumpkin candles, and Halloween decorations fill every corner—fake cobwebs, flickering candles, and a spooky ambient playlist filtering in from another room. His mom has really been going all out with the decorations this year since he hasn't been around for a few years. But as soon as you both turn toward the living room, your conversation fades. 

Standing before you is Evelyn, Alex’s mom, dressed in a striking Mavis Dracula cosplay that makes it hard to believe she’s anyone’s mom at all. She’s gone all out with the look: a jet-black bob wig, her eyes dramatically lined in dark makeup that makes her gaze look piercing yet playful, and dark black lipstick that frames her wide, inviting smile, complete with fake fangs in her mouth. But that’s not what catches your attention first.

The black dress she’s wearing hugs her curves in a way that makes it hard to look anywhere else. It clings to her like a second skin, molding around her thick, voluptuous body, emphasizing every inch of her generous figure. Her chest is full and bouncy, and the snug fit of the dress lifts her ample bust, making it impossible not to notice the way it practically spills over the top. Her wide hips sway with the smallest movement, curving out in a way that leaves little to the imagination, and her thick, shapely thighs peek out beneath the hem of the dress, accentuated by thigh-high red-and-black striped stockings. Her ass, soft and pillowy, gives her figure that full, hourglass shape that practically defines her presence.

She steps forward with a warm smile, her eyes sparkling with that familiar playful energy. “Happy Halloween, boys!” she greets, her voice rich and warm. She places her hands on her hips, the spiderweb gloves she's wearing adding a gothic touch that only makes her more alluring. “So… what do you think? Is it too much?” She gives a little spin, her hips swaying as she turns, before glancing over her shoulder with a playful grin, clearly enjoying your reactions.

Alex laughs awkwardly, clearly a bit embarrassed. “Mom, you didn’t have to go *all out* like that!”

Evelyn just winks, her gaze landing on you as she tilts her head, awaiting your answer with a mischievous glint in her eye. “I mean, Halloween’s the perfect time to have a little fun, right?” she says with a teasing smile. “But you have to tell me honestly… how does it look?”
